description: Passively probe a single URL with one HTTP(S) GET, following redirects. Returns the final status, the full redirect chain, response headers, a security-header audit (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, cookie Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite flags, and CORS origin-reflection), and an evidence-bound technology fingerprint (server, framework, CDN, WAF, CMS) drawn from headers and lightweight body markers. Strictly one request per host — no path traversal, parameter injection, or multi-method probing. Each redirect hop is validated against an SSRF guard. Use only on assets you own or are authorized to assess.

url.description: Absolute http:// or https:// URL to probe (e.g. "https://example.com"). Must be an http(s) URL; other schemes and private/loopback targets are rejected.

userAgent.description: Override the User-Agent header. Omit to use the server default.

name: attacksurface_probe_http

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `blocked_target`: The URL resolves to a private/loopback/metadata address, or uses a non-http(s) scheme. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

finalStatus.description: Final HTTP status code (0 when the probe errored).

notice.description: Guidance when the probe could not reach the target.

redirectChain.description: Redirect chain leading to the final response.

items.description: One hop in the redirect chain.

location.description: Location header that drove the next hop.

status.description: HTTP status returned at this hop.

items.description: Security-flag audit for one Set-Cookie header.

httpOnly.description: Whether the HttpOnly flag is set.

sameSite.description: SameSite attribute value, or null when absent.

secure.description: Whether the Secure flag is set.

corsReflectsOrigin.description: True when the server reflected an arbitrary request Origin into ACAO.

csp.description: Content-Security-Policy value, or null when absent.

findings.description: Human-readable findings for missing or weak headers.

hsts.description: Strict-Transport-Security value, or null when absent.

permissionsPolicy.description: Permissions-Policy value, or null when absent.

referrerPolicy.description: Referrer-Policy value, or null when absent.

xFrameOptions.description: X-Frame-Options value, or null when absent.

items.description: A technology detection with its triggering evidence.

evidence.description: The concrete evidence (header or body marker) that triggered the detection.

version.description: Version string when disclosed by the evidence.

transportError.description: Transport error, or null on success.

title: attacksurface_probe_http
